title: SOC2 daily scratchpad - evidence + vendor reviews
content:
Daily scratchpad - SOC2 focus

2024-10-02 (latest)
- Quick wins: uploaded missing MFA screenshots for admin accounts (app-console -> settings -> auth). Confirmed mgmt confirmation email sent to legal.
- Blockers: vendor A (LogStream) still missing updated SOC2 Type II report. They said 'Q4 delivery' in vendor portal; need escalation path.

Today goals
- Finish evidence packet for 'Access Management' control (AC-1..AC-6) and link artifacts in Confluence.
- Vendor review: compile questionnaire answers for LogStream and VaultCorp. Decide if temporary compensating control needed for LogStream until report arrives.
- Draft policy TODO: "Third-party risk escalation" doc (short steps + owner list).

To-do (short list)
- [ ] Evidence: attach admin MFA screenshots to CONFLUENCE:SECURITY-EVIDENCE-2024 (done? verify links)
- [ ] Evidence: export IAM role list for prod -> store in secure evidence folder (Jira: SEC-210)
- [ ] Vendor: follow up with LogStream AM for firm ETA + request bridge letter if available
- [ ] Vendor: review VaultCorp attestation emails and validate signature + cert chain
- [ ] Policy: stub "Vendor escalation flow" doc and assign owners (Ops, Legal, Security)
- [ ] Meeting: sync with Priya and Maya tomorrow at 10am PT (30m) - agenda: evidence gaps & vendor mitigation plan

Vendor review notes
- LogStream (ingest/logs)
  - Current status: provided SOC2 self-attestation 2023; Type II pending.
  - Risk: medium (ingests sensitive logs).
  - Compensating control idea: require log forwarding to our SIEM with immutable retention + restrict access to LogStream via dedicated service account.
  - Action: email AM (Alex) + Cc legal; request bridge letter or ISO cert. Add to vendor tracker.
  - Linked artifacts: vendor-contract-logs.pdf (internal), email-thread "LogStream SOC2"

- VaultCorp (secrets manager)
  - Status: provided Type II 2024 report (redacted). Verified auditor name matches ASN in report.
  - Risk: high if broken; but attestation current -> ok for now.
  - Action: store redacted report in evidence S3, set read-only perms for compliance team.

Policy TODOs (draft items)
- "Third-party risk escalation" (one-pager)
  - When to escalate (missing attestation > 60 days, high risk vendor, unresolved remediation after 30 days)
  - Who to notify: Vendor owner, Security lead, Legal, Product owner
  - Temporary mitigations: restricted access, additional monitoring, contract clause review
  - Template escalation email + bridge-letter request
- "Evidence retention mapping"
  - Map control -> artifact -> retention location (Confluence + S3 path) + owner + last-updated date
- "Access review cadence" (quarterly)
  - Owners: Infra-ops, IAM
  - Deliverables: attestation checkbox + list of privileged accounts

Notes to self / loose thoughts
- Double-check that evidence S3 buckets are encrypted with CMK and key rotation policy is documented (Confluence page?). If not, add to policy TODOs.
- Might ask Release Engineering for a small script to export IAM role bindings (CSV) weekly; opens a small ticket with infra.
- Consider adding a checkbox to product onboarding to enforce vendor attestation upload before production access. Could be a gating step in vendor onboarding playbook.

Meeting snippets (9/30 sync)
- Priya: suggested creating a "critical vendors" list (top 10) so we prioritize SOC2 evidence collection. Good idea.
- Maya: will take vault attestation and put into evidence S3 by EOD.
- Action items assigned: Priya -> vendor escalation template; Maya -> vault upload; Ethan (me) -> LogStream follow-up + policy stub.

Questions / unresolved
- Do we accept bridge letters as interim evidence? Legal to confirm. Action: Priya to loop Legal (JIRA: SEC-211).
- For temporary compensating controls, do we need engineer sign-off or is security lead enough? Need to document owner.

Quick links
- Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/SEC/Security+Evidence+2024
- Jira: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/SEC-210
- Vendor tracker sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1VendorTrackerMock
- Slack thread: #soc2-help-thread-09

Next steps (by EOD)
- Finalize "Vendor escalation" one-pager draft and upload to Confluence (assign Priya/Maya for review)
- Send follow-up to LogStream AM + Legal (short, ask for bridge letter or firm ETA). Put reminder in calendar + vendor tracker.
- Create INFRA ticket for IAM role export script and tag Release Engineering.

Random TODOs to file later
- Create small checklist doc for auditors: what we provide for each control (mapping).
- Clean up evidence folder naming conventions (current is messy)

Signature: Ethan B. (quick scratchpad - not final evidence doc)
